_doc: Cameras in plan cm (x east, y south, z up; first-floor floor at z = 310), house type 5 first floor. Same model as tip5-prizemlje.
exterior: first floor, about 3 m above the garden: through the glass a landscaped garden seen from slightly above in golden-hour light - the warm stone terrace and lawn below, olive trees, a clipped hedge, soft green hills far away under a warm golden sky with a few soft clouds. Never sea, never city, never night.
time_of_day: golden hour, about 18:30 in late spring - low warm sun from the south-west streams in through the glass, long soft honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls, warm glowing air; bright, warm and inviting - never night

fittings._head: Light fittings: ONLY these, exactly as modelled in IMAGE 1:
fittings.chandelier_crystal: the large pale stacked rings hanging in the void are the monumental three-tier crystal ring chandelier (champagne-bronze rings, cascading crystal rods), glowing warm
fittings.pendant_alabaster: small ivory cylinders hanging on cables are alabaster pendants glowing softly
fittings.pendant_opal_globe: the small white spheres on thin rods are opal glass globe pendants glowing softly
fittings.pendant_bronze: the long thin bronze bar on cables far below over the dining table is a linear bronze pendant
fittings.walnut_fluted: the short white lines under the stair treads are warm step lights
fittings.mirror_backlit: the mirror glows softly from behind
fittings.mirror_round_backlit: the mirror glows softly from behind
fittings.led_line: a pure-white line along the edge of a ceiling is a warm 2700K cove light, a white line under a vanity is a warm under-glow, a white line at the top of a slatted wall is a warm wash light
fittings._none: Light fittings: none in this view - golden-hour daylight only.
fittings._tail: Add NO other light of any kind: no spotlights, no downlights, no track lights, no recessed ceiling lights, no extra LED strips, no wall lights, no table lamps, no chandeliers other than the modelled one, no glowing outlines along edges. The thin GREY guide lines are not lights.
fittings._decor: Decor: only the modelled objects - fiddle-leaf figs and olive trees in stone pots (green sphere on a trunk), slim olive branches in small vases, framed paintings, books, rugs, sheer linen curtains; add no new objects.

cameras.title: Gallery office - across the glass balustrade into the double-height living
cameras.notes: The first-floor gallery office opens onto the double-height living through a frameless glass balustrade with a slim bronze top rail (no wall). Beyond the glass, at the same height, the monumental three-tier crystal ring chandelier hangs in the void; across the void the full-height fluted walnut wall with the series of brass-framed paintings and the floating walnut stair, and the tall south and east glass facades with golden-hour light; far below the living room floor in brown marble. In the gallery: the walnut desk with a cognac leather chair, two curved ivory boucle lounge chairs, a dark rug, an alabaster pendant. Through the glass: the view from the FIRST FLOOR, about 3 m above the garden, looking slightly DOWN onto it - the warm stone terrace and lawn below, olive trees, a clipped hedge, soft green hills on the horizon under a warm golden sky; low golden sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Gallery office - toward the desk, the painting and the landing
cameras.notes: The gallery office seen from beside the glass balustrade: the angled walnut desk, the cognac desk chair and two ivory boucle lounge chairs on a dark rug, the monumental abstract painting on the back wall, a tall olive or fig tree in the corner, the landing with a walnut console and a painting, the corridor to the bedrooms. The glass balustrade on the right edge with the void beyond.

cameras.title: Stair arrival - along the fluted walnut wall into the void
cameras.notes: From the top of the floating walnut stair: the treads go down along the fluted walnut wall with its stepped series of brass-framed paintings, the raked glass balustrade, the crystal chandelier in the void at eye level, the tall east glass facade with the golden-hour garden below, the living room below. Through the glass: the view from the FIRST FLOOR, about 3 m above the garden, looking slightly DOWN onto it - the warm stone terrace and lawn below, olive trees, a clipped hedge, soft green hills on the horizon under a warm golden sky; low golden sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Master bedroom - frontal view of the bed wall
cameras.notes: Frontal view of the master bed wall: dark espresso walnut boiserie with thin brass inlays across the whole wall, a tall cognac leather channel headboard, a cream textured artwork above it, two opal glass globe pendants on brass rods, cream travertine nightstands, ivory bedding, an ivory rug. Dark and moody with bright cream and brass details. No bench at the foot of the bed.

cameras.title: Master bedroom - toward the sliding glass and the TV wall
cameras.notes: From beside the bed toward the south sliding glass with sheer curtains and the walnut TV wall on the right; the bed on the left; golden-hour sun laying long warm patches across the dark walnut floor. Through the glass: the view from the FIRST FLOOR, about 3 m above the garden, looking slightly DOWN onto it - the warm stone terrace and lawn below, olive trees, a clipped hedge, soft green hills on the horizon under a warm golden sky; low golden sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Master ensuite - from the door
cameras.notes: Master ensuite, 70 % DARK: honed charcoal limestone walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; bright details: the white Calacatta Gold shower wall at the far end, the smoked-walnut double vanity with a cream travertine top on the right with two backlit mirrors. Clear glass shower, black fittings, ceiling cove. Moody, warm, luxurious. No window.

cameras.title: Bedroom 1 - frontal view of the bed wall
cameras.notes: Frontal view of the bed wall: vertical walnut slats with a warm wash light at the top, a tall olive velvet channel headboard, cream travertine nightstands, opal globe pendants, ivory bedding, an ivory rug; deep olive plaster walls; the full-height french window with sheer curtains on the left letting golden light in.

cameras.title: Bedroom 1 - toward the french window
cameras.notes: Toward the full-height french window with a glass Juliet balustrade and sheer curtains, the bed on the right, a fiddle-leaf fig in the corner. Through the glass: the view from the FIRST FLOOR, about 3 m above the garden, looking slightly DOWN onto it - the warm stone terrace and lawn below, olive trees, a clipped hedge, soft green hills on the horizon under a warm golden sky; low golden sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Bath 1 - shower, WC and window from the door
cameras.notes: Bath 1, 70 % DARK: deep green-black Verde marble walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; bright details: the floating cream travertine vanity slab with brushed-brass tap and a backlit mirror on the right, brushed-brass rain shower and flush plate, the walk-in shower behind clear glass on the left, a small high window above the WC with a little golden evening light. Moody and warm.

cameras.title: Bedroom 2 - frontal view of the bed wall
cameras.notes: Frontal view of the bed wall: ribbed smoked-oak panelling, a tall sand-linen channel headboard, ivory bedding with a rust linen throw, cream travertine nightstands, alabaster pendants, an ivory rug; warm charcoal plaster walls; the full-height window on the right with sheer curtains and golden light.

cameras.title: Bedroom 2 - toward the east window
cameras.notes: Toward the full-height east window with a glass Juliet balustrade and sheer curtains, the bed on the left, a fiddle-leaf fig in the corner. Through the glass: the view from the FIRST FLOOR, about 3 m above the garden, looking slightly DOWN onto it - the warm stone terrace and lawn below, olive trees, a clipped hedge, soft green hills on the horizon under a warm golden sky; low golden sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Bath 2 - shower, WC and window from the door
cameras.notes: Bath 2, 70 % DARK: dark chocolate Emperador marble walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; bright details: the white Calacatta Gold shower wall behind clear glass on the right, a smoked-walnut vanity with a white top and a backlit mirror on the left, a small high window above the WC. Moody and warm.
